newsitem.title: FRANCE: Casino names new mgmt board chairman.
newsitem.headline: Casino names new mgmt board chairman.

text.p: French retailer Groupe Casino said on Tuesday the supervisory board appointed Christian Couvreux to head the management board, replacing Georges Plassat.

It quoted supervisory board chairman Jean-Charles Naouri, head of the Euris holding company, the leading shareholder in Casino, as saying: "The appointment of Christian Couvreux, previously a director, shows our willingness to keep on to ensure new profit growth."
Board member Antoine Guichard was quoted in the Casino statement as saying he was in complete agreement with Naouri. Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
